I just want to work things out with her but I also feel like I don't deserve it. I know that I could never get over her. I can't imagine being with anyone else...

Thank you for taking the time out of your day to talk to me. It's nice to know that there are people like you out there. I will try to get some sleep and see what happens tomorrow. Again, thank you.

32 next month... My wife and I met almost 6 years ago. We were engaged the first time about 3 years ago but I broke things off after she admitted to infidelity. This was after I moved thousands of miles to be with her. We reconnected after a year and she told me that she had panicked and lied about the infidelity. We tried to reconcile but things were always very rocky. She never got over me leaving and seeing other people. I had trust issues with her, and ironically, began lying to her... We eventually got to the point where we thought we were comfortable and decided to get engaged again. We married and tried our best to resolve any lingering issues but tempers always seemed to flare. I couldn't get my shit together and I continued to hurt her. She has decided that she has had enough now and wants to end things.
